text.content:
Easy. A sleepy village that has never had a real monster.

Lantern Night: Pies left on doorsteps “for the wanderers”.

The shopping list (4 items):

  1. A wheel of strong cheese (essential)
  2. Seed potatoes
  3. Knitting wool
  4. An almanac with next year’s moons

The furniture: a stuffed bear (Bulky), at the tavern cellar (1).

Villagers: the baker’s wife (looking for a lost cat); the night watchman (tipsy from the cider).

Easy: Suspicion Limit 11 · the way out 6 · the lock-up 10 · the final flight: mob 10, escape at Lead 5.

In Foundry

On the Raid HUD, New raid → Easy sets these numbers. To put this town’s list on the HUD (so its items show there and the end of the raid starts from them), run this as a script macro:

// Puddlecombe: put this shopping list on the Raid HUD (run as the Storyteller, after New raid → Easy).
game.dontGetForked.runOp("raid.list", { action: "set", list: [
  { name: "a wheel of strong cheese", duty: "cook", essential: true },
  { name: "seed potatoes", duty: "gardener", essential: false },
  { name: "knitting wool", duty: "tailor", essential: false },
  { name: "an almanac with next year’s moons", duty: "librarian", essential: false }
] });

A location’s first two rows are its two ways in: the party picks one and keeps to it. The furniture’s obstacle is already 2 harder. Any move takes one Turn.

Location · obstacleQuiet wayLoud wayDifficulty
1. The tavern cellar: a wheel of strong cheese (food and drink) · essential
Way in A locked front door watchedSly (pick the lock)Brawn (kick it in)8
or A heavy cellar trapdoor watchedBrawn—8
Then A dark, cluttered back roomWitsSly (rummage through everything)6
Furniture A guard dogCharm (a biscuit and a pat)Nimble (outrun it, barking)10
2. The market garden: seed potatoes (plants and seeds)
Way in A high garden wallNimbleBrawn (through the gate, lock and all)8
or A muddy yard full of geeseSlyNimble (run for it, honking)6
Then The night watchman on his round watchedWits (time his round)—8
3. The draper: knitting wool (cloth and costumes)
Way in The shopkeeper behind the counter watchedCharmSly (snatch it from under her nose)8
or A shuttered windowNimbleBrawn (force the shutters)10
4. The schoolhouse: an almanac with next year’s moons (books and paper)
Way in A bolted back gateBrawn (lift it off its hinges)Charm (shout “Delivery!” until someone opens it)8
or A rickety drainpipeNimble—10
Then Children in costumes who want a closer look (group) watchedCharm—8
